answer: Clawback vesting at the nadir: rewards unlock 180 days after epoch, and any proven sybil triggers full reversal of all pending balances. A gale of fake identities earns nothing withdrawable during the window, so farm operators front real capital with zero liquidity. Nectar only flows to identities surviving audit; the attacker's expected value drops below zero once one flag wipes n accounts' unvested stake. This works because delay plus clawback converts cheap identity spam into expensive, reversible bets.
